{"metadata":{"description":"a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Cordis plugin that bridges a session's activity into agentmemory, a local, self-hosted memory daemon.","id":"gh:1334965864","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-agentmemory","slug":"Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory","topics":["agentmemory","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Cordis plugin that bridges a session's activity into agentmemory, a local, "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"self-hosted memory daemon."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-agentmemory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Cordis plugin that gives every dsh session a persistent, searchable memor"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"y in agentmemory — a local, self-hosted memory daemon with a REST API."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **⚠️ Deprecated.** This plugin is no longer maintained. agentmemory 0.9.29+ ships an official dsh "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"connector that supersedes it — migrate with:
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":">
> The official connector covers auto-capture (hooks bridged through the first-party `dsh-hooks-cla"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ude-code`) and the MCP memory tools; this plugin's `agent/pre-step` context injection has no officia"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"l equivalent. Already-written memories and observations stay in the daemon (keyed by project/agentId"},{"id":"p6s4","text":") and remain queryable after migration — though the project/agentId the official connector stamps ma"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"y differ from this plugin's (git-toplevel project, `dsh` agentId). While transitioning, pick one per"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" profile: the daemon's dedup cannot merge the two capture streams, so running both duplicates rows."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"dsh sessions are ephemeral: once a session ends, everything the agent learned — the tool calls it ma"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"de, the errors it recovered from, the decisions it settled on — is gone. agentmemory fixes that with"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" cross-session, cross-harness persistence (it already serves Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes and more)"},{"id":"p7s4","text":". This plugin is the dsh side of that ecosystem: it **writes** every session's activity into the dae"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"mon as observations, **reads** memory back into the model at the right moments, and exposes explicit"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" **memory tools** the agent can call."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Three surfaces, one plugin:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Surface | What it does |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install (static composition)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Start the agentmemory daemon first — the plugin's load gate requires it. The daemon's default REST p"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ort is `3111`; see the agentmemory quickstart for install options (`npx -y @agentmemory/agentmemory@"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"latest`). Verified against agentmemory 0.9.29; ≥ 0.9.29 required:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> - Older 0.9.x drops `agentId` on `/agentmemory/remember`, so agent-scoped recall filters out every"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" saved memory.
> - Older 0.9.x observe dedup collapses rows that carry no `tool_input` (this plugin'"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s approval → notification rows) onto one shared key per 5-minute window, silently dropping the secon"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"→ notification rows) onto one shared key per 5-minute window, silently dropping the second approval."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then install the package from GitHub into a profile:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"(A local dev checkout also works via `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/checkout`.)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Mount the row from `cordis-row.example.yml` into a host composition `cordis.yml` (or into a per-sess"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ion agent preset's composition under `${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/.agent-presets/<id>/`). The minimal ro"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"w is just `{name}` — Cordis validates it against the plugin's `Config` schema and fills defaults (qu"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ote the name if it is a scoped package, i.e. starts with `@`, which YAML treats as a reserved scalar"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"e the name if it is a scoped package, i.e. starts with `@`, which YAML treats as a reserved scalar):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Requires Node >= 20, a `shell` capability seam (the standard bash/pwsh executors), and a dsh harne"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ss matching the `peerDependencies` ranges in package.json (verified against dsh-tools 0.1.1-rc.2 and"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" 0.1.2-rc.1). Every key the row accepts is listed under Configuration keys. Validation commands: see"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"Every key the row accepts is listed under Configuration keys. Validation commands: see Verification."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## DSH event → agentmemory mapping registry"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Why `tool/call` emits no observation row"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The `tool/result` row already carries name + args (via `callMeta`, stashed when the call event passe"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"s through) plus the output as one standard `post_tool_use`. A separate call row would either sit out"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"side the extraction set (see the note above the table) or collide with the result row's dedup key (s"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ame `tool_name` + args) and silently drop the result's output. So the call is recorded, but only as "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"metadata for the result row."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Why `turn/end` borrows `post_tool_use`"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Purely so the turn's `reason` reaches `tool_output` and thus the searchable synthetic narrative (a c"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ustom hookType would leave it invisible — same reason as above). `assistant/message` does the same f"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"would leave it invisible — same reason as above). `assistant/message` does the same for its content."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Why `approval/asked` maps to `notification`"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`notification` is the hookType Claude Code's Notification hook and OpenCode's permission events prod"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"uce, so approval prompts from dsh land in the same typed, rendered bucket the daemon already knows. "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"By design the daemon does not content-index notifications, so no field here needs extraction-friendl"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"e daemon does not content-index notifications, so no field here needs extraction-friendly placement."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Why `compaction/summary` goes to `/remember`"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The distilled summary is free, daemon-adjacent memory — persisting it as a durable fact means it sur"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"vives the very history compression that produced it, instead of dying with the compacted transcript."},{"id":"p29s3","text":" Capped at 6000 chars, off via `compactionBridge: false`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Tool-side vs bridge-side project resolution**: the observation bridge resolves the project as `A"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"GENTMEMORY_PROJECT_NAME` env → git toplevel → cwd basename, but `memory_recall` / `memory_remember` "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"default to the session cwd basename only. When the session cwd is a subdirectory of a git repo, obse"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"rvations land under the toplevel project name while the tools query the cwd basename — pass `project"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"` explicitly to bridge the gap.
- **No read-only mode**: `enabled: false` cuts both the observation "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"bridge and the injection data sources (only the model tools stay live). Injecting context without wr"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"iting observations is not currently possible.
- **Memory is shared across sessions by default** (obs"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ervations are stamped with the plugin agentId, not the DSH session id); to isolate one agent, set `a"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"gentId` or filter `memory_recall` by it.
- **Agent isolation is opt-in**: written rows carry the plu"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"gin agentId (see Configuration keys); rows written by plugin versions that predate agentId stamping "},{"id":"p31s11","text":"have `agentId` undefined and stay recallable when the filter is omitted.
- **Environment variables**"},{"id":"p31s12","text":" (`AGENT_ID`, `AGENTMEMORY_PROJECT_NAME`) are read from the dsh host process environment via the `sh"},{"id":"p31s13","text":"ell` seam — set them where dsh is launched, not in `cordis.yml`.
- **The bridge does not modify any "},{"id":"p31s14","text":"`@deepseek-ai` package** and does not touch the shipped preset install directory."}],"truncated":true}
